answer: Proof of Compute provides an oasis for decentralized networks by requiring agents to expend verifiable energy to participate. Like drops in an ocean, each unique task proof consumes nectar in the form of computational fuel, making mass identity replication economically irrational. An attacker faces a linear cost increase for every fake node, as they must dedicate non-trivial hardware and electricity to sustain each artificial persona, rendering large-scale Sybil expansion prohibitively expensive.
